title: Selected ACR image has no HIGH or CRITICAL package vulnerabilities
description: Reviews an explicitly selected immutable ACR image with an offline package vulnerability database. Verified HIGH or CRITICAL findings remain visible when scan coverage is incomplete; a clean result requires a fresh complete scan. The selected digest does not prove a workload runs the image or that a finding is exploitable.
pass_when: The bound image and fresh complete scan have no HIGH or CRITICAL findings.
fail_when: The bound image has at least one typed HIGH or CRITICAL finding, including when scan coverage is incomplete.
unknown_when: The native image binding, content graph, scanner version, database freshness or scan coverage is incomplete.
remediation: Update affected packages, rebuild the image, and select a reviewed immutable digest.
